notes: ASUS ExpertBook B1403CVA business laptop (BIOS B1403CVA.317). Intel Core i5-1335U (2P+8E, 12T), Intel UHD Graphics only (no dGPU; LHM gives no GPU temperature). 1x16GB DDR5-5200 SODIMM (Samsung). The NVMe drive (Micron MTFDKBA512QGN) sits behind Intel RST/VMD, so LHM names it /raid/0 — its temperature was dropped before the storage-prefix filter went. No Super I/O, no fan headers; the ASUS ACPI fan/mode ids all fail on this model.
